purpose: Classify free or near-free execution surfaces that can reduce repo-side blockers without satisfying live HPC parity claims.
claim_boundary: Free CPU/container routes can prove packaging, build, smoke, and contract behavior. They cannot prove production HPC parity, Slurm scheduling, parallel filesystem throughput, native GPU speedup, or weak/strong scaling certification unless the route records real live-hpc manifests with raw artifacts and checksums.

routes.access_model: free for public repositories on standard GitHub-hosted runners
blockers_reduced: Track 54 Docker image build and CLI help smoke through GitHub-hosted Docker runtime
Track 51/52/55 validator execution on clean Linux/Windows runners
Track 55 local scaling placeholder runner and aggregator checks
not_proof_for: native GPU kernel parity or speedup

routes.access_model: standard macOS GitHub-hosted runner for public repository workflow smoke
blockers_reduced: Track 52/33 Metal-adjacent compile and WebGPU smoke confidence
GPU docs and shader-surface regression checks
not_proof_for: wgpu native adapter parity on target HPC GPU

blockers_reduced: Public CPU-only demo or smoke harness for local scaling placeholder JSON
Independent Linux CPU environment for docs/demo reproducibility

routes.access_model: requested or on-demand GPU/ZeroGPU-style Space when available
blockers_reduced: Ad hoc GPU availability smoke when a Space is granted suitable hardware
NVIDIA-visible dependency and device enumeration smoke
required_evidence: GPU model as reported by the runtime
not_proof_for: Track 52 benchmark threshold without a completed live-hpc manifest

routes.access_model: Docker engine available inside applicable GitHub-hosted Linux jobs
blockers_reduced: Track 54 Docker build and CLI smoke when cloud-smoke passes
Container packaging regression detection

routes.provider: Local Apple Silicon macOS Host (Homebrew + Metal + Colima/Lima)
routes.access_model: zero-cost local execution on maintainer Apple Silicon Mac using native Metal GPU, Homebrew OpenMPI 5.x, hwloc, protoc, and Colima/Lima Linux VMs
blockers_reduced: Track 52 real wgpu Metal hardware adapter/device/queue initialization, WGSL compute shader dispatch, and persistent device-memory readback parity
Track 49 local multi-rank mpiexec --oversubscribe -np 4 and two-process gRPC socket smoke
Track 50 hwloc-ls / sysctl topology discovery and thread-pool arena contention testing
Track 53 native macOS .dylib FMU dynamic symbol loading and OpenModelica CLI (brew install --cask openmodelica) roundtrip
required_evidence: system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType or Metal adapter report
not_proof_for: Lustre or GPFS parallel filesystem throughput

routes.provider: Local Colima / Lima + Docker Compose (c2platform/docker-slurm & k3d/kind)
routes.access_model: free local Linux container cluster emulation on macOS via Colima/Lima
blockers_reduced: Track 54 local sbatch/srun/scontrol script validation against containerized Slurmctld/Slurmd nodes
Track 54 local Kubernetes job manifest reconciliation via k3d/kind and kubectl
Track 51 local HDF5 (brew install hdf5) and Parquet/ADIOS2 multi-process checkpoint restart verification
not_proof_for: production bare-metal Slurm HPC cluster acceptance

routes.provider: Google Colab / Kaggle Kernels / Lightning.ai Free Tier
routes.access_model: free-tier NVIDIA T4 / P100 / L4 GPU notebook and container sessions (30h/week on Kaggle, free T4 on Colab)
blockers_reduced: Track 52 real NVIDIA CUDA driver/runtime context creation, PTX/kernel dispatch, and CPU/CUDA parity verification without paid cloud GPU instances
Track 52 wgpu Vulkan-on-NVIDIA Linux adapter smoke and benchmark capture
not_proof_for: Lustre or GPFS parallel storage throughput
